title: Vendor redelivers the same event twice
description: The same inbound event (workflow callback / vendor webhook) is delivered twice with the same event id after the first delivery was processed.
callerVisible: No caller-visible change; the caller receives one reference and one neutral notification at most.
backendEvidence: Second delivery deduplicated by event id / idempotency key
One workflow transition and one support record
notes: Reach evidence: on the transfer path the telephony emulator flags each duplicate delivery it made (TELEPHONY_DUPLICATE_EVENTS_<n>, an emulator log). On the outbox path the only local signal is the LOCAL FIXTURE driver's own count of the delivered messages it published again with the same ids (DUPLICATE_REDELIVERIES_<n>): a driver self-report, never reach evidence, so an outbox-path run is INCONCLUSIVE (reached null, observedBy 'driver_notes.outbox_redelivered (driver self-report)'). Both counters are carried in the driver's notes until the evidence collector (WP-34) records them as typed fields. Neither is an inbox row; the Layer-2 run [FAULT:DUPLICATE_WEBHOOK] (WP-04) proves the duplicate with the inbox and consumer-dedup rows.

registry.injectionPoint: inbound inbox redelivery with the same (tenant, source, event_id) and outbox redelivery

postconditions: A redelivered event with the same id is deduplicated: one workflow transition, one support record, one dial per attempt
The attempt history never repeats, reverses or skips a state
